instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a SINGLE hybrid design pulling features exactly as specified: 1) USE dir1 background color (#efe7da) and text color (#2b2119) globally. 2) IMPLEMENT 'Where I've Shipped' section strictly using dir1's design pattern (grid-cols-12, date on left in tabular font, details on right, border-t and border-b dividers). 3) IMPLEMENT Skills section using dir2's code/terminal representation (e.g., $ cat skills.yml), utilizing a monospace font, blinking cursor, and earthy green syntax colors on dark bg. 4) IMPLEMENT Hero with dir3's layout: left hero animation featuring smooth dynamic writing/typewriter effect for H1, and heavy curved edges (rounded-[24px]) for the right-side visual panel. ENSURE the overall feel remains a personal portfolio and not a product page by focusing on the builder/engineer narrative. Strict adherence to provided user facts—do not add headshots.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure generous padding (p-8 to p-12) within containers. Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-[24px] components. Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, button scales, and text entrance animations on scroll. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
